content: Nyampunya yimi ngurrjuju yangka kalalu-jana maralypikingarduyu-patu wangkaja yapakuju
“Nyampu-jana wangkaya Yarunuku manu nyanungu-nyangu kaja-nyanu-patuku, ‘Kajinkili-janarla YAAWIYI-ki wangka yapa-patuku, kujalu-jana wangkaya,
Payirni karnalu-nyarrarla YAAWIYI yungu-nyarra ngurrju nyina manu yungu-nyarra yimiri nyina.
Payirni karnalu-nyarrarla YAAWIYI yungu wungu-warnu nyurrurla-nyangu tarnnga nyina, manu yungunkulurla nyiya-ngurlurlangu lani-wangu marlaja nyina rarralypa nyiyarningkijarra-ngurlu.” ’”

Ngula-jangka, YAAWIYI-rla wangkaja Mujujuku, “Kajijili ngaju Yarunurlu manu nyanungu-nyangu kaja-nyanu-paturlu payirni yangka Yijirali-pinkiki yapaku, kapurna-jana pirrjirdi-maninjarla warrawarra-kanyi.”…
